info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Auto Insurance Quotes Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Auto Insurance Quotes API allows users to effectively manage and cancel existing auto insurance quotes. This API is designed for insurance, brokerage, and financial service providers who need to streamline the cancellation process for customer quotes. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure that quoting records are accurately reflected in the system, thus improving operational efficiency and customer service. Ideal for developers integrating quote management capabilities, this API enhances the overall user experience for quote handling.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an existing quote. Once a quote is canceled, it cannot be reinstated. Make sure to confirm your decision before proceeding.

requestBody.description: Request payload for canceling a quote, which includes the necessary identifiers to locate the specific quote to be canceled.

206.description: Partial content returned; the request was successful but only a subset of the expected data is provided.
